mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Inflationary pressure (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized) erodes real equity returns through nominal rate adjustments, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth rate below 0.5% annualized signals economic contraction, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS increase) and unemployment decline (UNRATE decrease) signal labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market expansion (HOUST > 1100) signals rising construction activity that precedes economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1100.
